scope: Path reconciliation only. Replacement status identifies current source, not full hosted, physical or study acceptance.

entries.note: Pause, tracking cancellation, session teardown and account ownership are implemented across these modules. Physical sleep/tracking acceptance remains deferred.
Guest provision/reset uses the common projects client and dedicated bounded Edge handler, not a separate frontend demo service.
Bounded model scope, typed tools and measured results replace the planned standalone context serializer.
Stable source IDs and selection are supplied by view/picking/port modules. The production implementation does not use the planned ReviewTarget ECS component.
Native WebXR select events and explicit tracked-hand gating replace the planned IWSDK Pressed system. Both-hand/cancel software checks pass; physical input remains unmeasured.
The world-anchored canvas panel invokes the same typed review controller as desktop controls. It replaces the planned UIKit panel system.

Device-local bounded text/panel size and high contrast settings now persist, are available in desktop guide and both-hand XR controls, and cancel held intent on changes. Storage refusal is explicit. Physical readability/reach/comfort still unmeasured.
Programmatic spatial canvas buttons replace the planned UIKitML asset. The original layout geometry is a design target, not an asserted physical acceptance result.
Service-only bounded cleanup rechecks eligibility before deletion. Actual production scheduler responses additionally show three completed eligible cleanups.

The offline generator validates canonical input, requires explicit distinct targets, preserves point/licence bytes and unrelated metadata, injects three disclosed faults, and writes deterministic output plus complete world-space references. Synthetic regression cases verify its numerical and refusal behavior. External rights, natural annotation correctness and a fresh independent real-clip workflow remain unverified.
Explicit pinned PGlite schema/claims/grants/transaction assertions replace the obsolete SQL entrypoint. They are synthetic fixtures, not destructive hosted tests.

Source/browser/Linux/Windows/SQL/Python/advisory checks are complemented by caller-owned live staging integration and an isolated PostgreSQL dump/restore rehearsal. Actual per-run receipts determine acceptance. Hosted managed-backup, OTP, physical and reviewer evidence remain separate.

The consolidated guarded PowerShell entrypoint verifies a clean source checkout, public-only environment, generated bundles and selected project; deployment switches invoke pinned provider CLIs and exact frontend readback. Source availability and parse checks do not imply operator authentication or a successful publication.
The public site serves the actual privacy page from public/privacy.html, canonical route /privacy.
The public site serves the actual help page from public/help.html, canonical route /help.

The deployed project-cleanup endpoint uses a separate exact bounded bearer, no browser origin, private Vault dispatcher and 15-minute Cron job. This supersedes the originally planned X-Cleanup-Secret interface.
